summary.text: Aaron Michlewitz is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 3rd Suffolk District since 2009 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Michlewitz took office in 2009 and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the House Ways and Means Committee and of the joint Ways and Means committee for the 2021-2022, 2023-2024 and 2025-2026 sessions.
